name: dream_canary_consecutive_failures
description: Dream canary has failed at least twice consecutively; resets only on a complete verified synthetic pass.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend-sync" AND (textPayload =~ "Dream canary status=fail .*consecutive_failures=([2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)( |$)" OR jsonPayload.message =~ "Dream canary status=fail .*consecutive_failures=([2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)( |$)")
